p: fellowship: To give, and occupy for the use of him that gave it.
violence: By any deceit, or unlawful means.
sinning therein: In which he cannot but sin: or, in which a man accustoms to sin by perjury or such like thing.
law of the burnt offering: That is, the ceremony which ought to be observed in it.
his flesh: Upon his secret parts, Ex 28:42.
altar: In the ash pans appointed for that use.
baken with leaven: Or, kneaded with leaven and baked.
perpetual: So oft as the high priest shall be elected and anointed.
anointed in his stead shall offer: His son that shall succeed him.
garment: Meaning, the garment of the priest.
water: Which was in the laver, Ex 30:28.
fire: Out of the camp Le 4:12.
